_note: Curated background-music library. Descriptions drive the runtime LLM match against each reel. Audio files live alongside this manifest and are gitignored (copyright); this metadata is tracked. Each section = one hit passage. Section fields: id, start, end (seconds), lyrics (romanized line the section opens on, or '(instrumental)'), description (vibe + when to use). method 'lyric' = onset pinned to a verified lyric; otherwise acoustic (energy/beat).

songs.title: Chak De India (Title Track)
songs.description: Urgent, high-energy anthem of collective grit, do-or-die perseverance, and redefined patriotism where pride means rising above your limits and proving doubters wrong. Best for victory/comeback/underdog-triumph, sports montages, team-unity and training-grind edits, national-pride moments, any 'we refused to lose' celebration.

sections.description: Opens on 'chak de, chak de india' — the explosive rallying-cry chant of collective triumph and pride; drop it on the winning moment, the trophy lift, the crowd going wild, or the payoff frame of a comeback.

songs.title: Tera Naam Japdi Phiran (Cocktail)
songs.description: Flirty, intoxicated, devotion-meets-rebellion love song where the singer is helplessly hooked, endlessly chanting the beloved's name — romantic surrender with a playful bad-girl swagger. Best for romance, crush/falling-in-love, carefree fun and party reels, confident glow-up or main-character-energy edits, playful couple content.

sections.lyrics: dil lutiya aaye mast nigawan / tera naam japdi phiran
sections.description: Opens on 'dil lutiya aaye mast nigawan / tera naam japdi phiran' — a swooning, love-struck confession of a heart stolen by someone's gaze; use for a reveal, a crush moment, or a dreamy romantic gaze.

songs.title: Manzar Hai Yeh Naya (URI)
songs.description: Soaring cinematic motivation anthem about a fearless person marching into a bright new dawn — carrying the sun on their shoulders, lightning in their hands, treating storms as trivial. Best for comeback/new-chapter/fresh-start, hustle and self-improvement montages, courage-in-adversity edits, epic 'unstoppable' hero moments.

sections.lyrics: manzar hai ye naya, manzar naya
sections.description: Opens on 'manzar hai ye naya, manzar naya' — the dawn of a new chapter and fresh beginning; use for a transformation reveal, a turning point, or the start of a new journey/comeback.

sections.lyrics: kandhe pe suraj tikake chala tu / haathon mein bharke chala bijliyan
sections.description: Opens on 'kandhe pe suraj tikake chala tu / haathon mein bharke chala bijliyan' — the peak power-and-fearlessness surge, hero as unstoppable and storm-proof; drop it on the climactic push, the grind paying off, or raw determination.

songs.title: Arz Kiya Hai (Coke Studio Bharat)
songs.description: Soft, intimate, poetic confession of love where the singer becomes a poet through the pain and beauty of loving someone — tender, vulnerable, quiet longing. Best for heartfelt romance, longing/yearning, nostalgic or bittersweet edits, gentle emotional storytelling, slow sentimental couple or memory reels.

sections.lyrics: ishq me tere hain faiz bane, arz kiya hai
sections.description: Opens on 'ishq me tere hain faiz bane, arz kiya hai' — the humble poetic declaration that love turned the singer into a poet (invoking Urdu poet Faiz); use for a tender confession, a heartfelt dedication, or a soft vulnerable romantic climax.

songs.title: Vaaroon (Mirzapur)
songs.description: Soulful, tender ballad of total romantic devotion and surrender — the lover gives themselves completely and stops caring about the rest of the world, loyal through joy and sorrow. Fits romance/yearning, wedding and couple montages, loyal-partner tributes, slow intimate love reels.

sections.lyrics: tune daara jo preet ka dora / manwa bairi rehna
sections.description: Opens on the beloved 'casting the thread of love' that finally tamed the singer's once-rebellious heart; use for a couple falling in love or surrendering to each other — a soft turning-point about being changed and captured by someone's love.

songs.title: O Rangrez (Bhaag Milkha Bhaag)
songs.description: Semi-classical Sufi love song (raag Khamaj, ache of separation) built on the dyer-coloring-cloth metaphor — a plea to be dyed in the beloved's color and dissolve into their essence; works as earthly romance AND devotional/spiritual longing. Fits reflective/spiritual, yearning romance, self-transformation and surrender arcs, soulful devotional montages.

sections.lyrics: rang rina rang dena / apni hi rang mein mujhko rang de
sections.description: Opens on the core plea 'color me in your own color' — the emotional heart, a slow surrendering cry to merge entirely into the beloved; use for peak longing, devotion, or giving oneself over completely.
Vocal-free semi-classical interlude — meditative, yearning, slightly melancholic; use under reflective voiceover, spiritual/introspective montage, or as breathing space before an emotional payoff.

songs.title: En paix (Instrumental High Bass)
songs.description: Emotive cinematic hip-hop instrumental with heavy resonant bass and a soulful, dramatic vibe — confident, intense, slightly bittersweet. Fits grit-and-triumph energy: personal comebacks, hustle/entrepreneur montages, transformation reveals, moody urban lifestyle.

sections.description: A powerful, arresting opening that plants a bold, weighty bass foundation; use as a hook-grabbing bed under the first seconds of a reel to signal impact and command attention.

songs.title: Cornfield Chase (Interstellar)
songs.description: Uplifting-yet-melancholic cinematic build (Interstellar) balancing hope and heartbreak, growing from a quiet ostinato into an awe-inducing organ swell. Ideal for aspirational/emotional reels: dream-chasing, epic reveals, longing goodbyes, space/nature grandeur, anything both inspiring and wistful.

sections.description: The rising build toward the soaring organ swell; layer under a climactic reveal or triumphant/emotional payoff so the visuals crest exactly as the music opens up into awe.

songs.title: River Flows in You (Yiruma)
songs.description: Tranquil, tender solo-piano piece — reflective, romantic, quietly bittersweet; evokes love, memory, gentle introspection. Perfect for calm/heartfelt reels: weddings and couple moments, nostalgic montages, soft storytelling, self-care, emotional voiceovers needing an unobtrusive tender bed.

sections.description: The steady, flowing main theme; use as a smooth continuous emotional bed under intimate or nostalgic footage where you want gentle forward motion without demanding attention.

songs.title: Bombay Theme (A.R. Rahman)
songs.description: Hauntingly beautiful, melancholic orchestral theme (A.R. Rahman) fusing soaring Indian flute with sweeping strings — serenity, longing, tragedy, inner reflection. Best for poignant soulful reels: heritage/culture, tender tragedy or loss, spiritual/meditative moments, sweeping emotional storytelling with a peaceful yet heavy heart.

sections.description: The signature soaring flute melody — haunting and serene; use over reflective, emotional, or bittersweet visuals to evoke longing and moving, tearful poignancy.

songs.title: Beanie (Chezile)
songs.description: Dreamy, melancholic bedroom-pop (hazy lo-fi, viral 2023). Sad, reflective, aching with unspoken longing — missing someone, emotional stillness after things fade. Fits heartbreak, wistful nostalgia, quiet-sad, introspective or bittersweet-aesthetic moments.

sections.description: First minute — hazy, melancholic build; use as a wistful bed under nostalgic, heartbreak, missing-someone, or quiet-emotional/aesthetic footage.

songs.title: Chaudhary (Amit Trivedi ft. Mame Khan, Coke Studio)
songs.description: Majestic Rajasthani folk-fusion (Coke Studio) — earthy, celebratory yet longing, a powerful mans devotion; grand, cultural, soulful with festive energy. Fits heritage/culture, weddings, roots and homecoming, proud-devotion, and grand emotional or celebratory reels.

sections.description: Instrumental Rajasthani folk build from ~1:10 — earthy sarangi/percussion groove, majestic and celebratory; use as a cultural, grand, or festive bed.
